result.instructions: Tools for Protime, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the clockings of person 42 for last week."; "Who is absent next Monday, and with which absence type?"; "List all departments and work locations in our Protime tenant.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Protime data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run protime_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run protime_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run protime_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. protime_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: protime_list_clockings
tools.title: List clockings
tools.description: List time clockings (in/out, reasons, activities) for a date range. Deleted clockings have status Deleted. Location data is left out. A date range is required (at most one year). Returns one page: pass continuationToken for the next page. Read only. Needs scope connector-protimeapi-clockings.read.

person.description: Internal person IDs. Leave out for all people.

continuationToken.description: continuationToken from the previous page (use the same other arguments).
